title: Mechanisms of breathing
brief_description: The human breathing system in operation. Animated diagrams illustrated the exchange of gases in the lungs and body tissue cells, including pathological conditions. Artificial respiration is demonstrated, and the nervous control of breathing, and factors affecting the rate and depth of respiration.
